title: [Agent Archiving] Fix broken reference links to archived agents and their tasks
summary: Reference links to archived agents and their tasks now open the Agent Card and Agent Task Log Entries respectively instead of failing or showing unrelated agents, while non-archived agents follow the same navigation paths as before.
key_points: Archived agents are now reachable for auditing through proper navigation surfaces
Agent task references on Inbound E-Documents and agent drill-downs now route to appropriate pages when agents are archived
Two internal helper methods route navigation based on agent substate to either task pane or card/log views
Non-archived agents experience no behavior change
External apps can replicate the logic using existing public APIs without waiting for client-side changes
quote: Reference links to an archived agent or to an archived agent's task are broken.
